'''2007 Endor Regionals Phil Aasen LS Naboo: Otoh Gunga Entrance''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Phil Aasen]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' Phillip Aasen
* '''Deck name:''' It's 3 a.m. and I want to go to bed.
* '''Username:''' korreshark
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
